audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text never named a single Yone ability and leaned on invented shorthand ("his Q3", "E-rewind").
audit.why: Riot names are Way of the Hunter (P), Mortal Steel (Q), Spirit Cleave (W), Soul Unbound (E), Fate Sealed (R). Pantheon is 54.84% over 2170 Emerald+ games — early-dominant, falls off.
audit.corrected: Early text now states the real level-1/2 pattern (point-and-click Shield Vault stun + tapped Comet Spear vs an unstacked Spirit Cleave shield) and the fall-off is tied to Yone crit/on-hit items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text described Yone spikes without naming what actually comes online, and the itemization line claimed Executioner's Calling counters "his healing" — Yone has no healing in his kit.
audit.why: Yone kit has no heal; his defensive layer is Spirit Cleave's shield (14s). Pantheon spikes: levels 2-3, Eclipse/Serrated Dirk first item, level 6 Grand Starfall roams (180s at rank 1). Yone spikes: Soul Unbound rank-ups (22 down to 10s) and crit/on-hit items.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Spirit Cleave's shield, the 2-stack Mortal Steel dash-knockup and Fate Sealed; itemization line swapped to Plated Steelcaps vs crit autos plus Way of the Hunter magic hits.

audit.whatIsWrong: No ability interaction was ever stated. Missing: Spirit Cleave shielding the burst window (flagged in _missing-interactions.json), Mortal Steel needing two hits to arm its dash-knockup, and Aegis Assault being front-only.
audit.why: Riot text: Mortal Steel grants Gathering Storm stacks, at 2 stacks it dashes and knocks up; Spirit Cleave shields on cast, 14s; Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s repeats a portion of his damage on the rewind; Aegis Assault makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the front only.
audit.corrected: Text now says: force Spirit Cleave out before committing, hold Aegis Assault facing him, break the Gathering Storm stack timer by stepping out, and commit while Soul Unbound is on its 22s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown windows were vague ("his answer", "your committal tool").
audit.why: Real numbers make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1 now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spell shield / cleanse / tenacity / knockup-interrupt behaviour for Mortal Steel's knockup against the Aegis Assault channel is not in Riot data.
audit.why: Kit needsResearch is empty by design — unknown, not "no".

edits.before: Your point-and-click W stun into Q tap-thrust out-damages a Yone with no W-cleave power yet — force trades every level.
edits.after: Point-blank Shield Vault (W) stun into a Q tap beats a Yone whose Spirit Cleave shield is still unstacked — trade every level.

edits.before: Eclipse / Serrated Dirk is your peak — W in, E-block his Q-dash damage, empowered-Q to finish before he gets cleave items.
edits.after: Eclipse / Serrated Dirk is your peak — bait Spirit Cleave's 14s shield out first, then W in and empowered-Q before his crit items.

edits.before: Yone's threat window: with crit and on-hit cleave he Q-dashes through you, R-knockups you, and E-rewinds out of your W all-in.
edits.after: Yone's window: crit online, Mortal Steel's 2-stack dash knocks you up, Fate Sealed pulls you in, and Soul Unbound undoes your W all-in.

edits.before: Hold E to block his Q-dash damage and bait his E-rewind, then re-engage with W
edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at his dash, bait Soul Unbound, then re-engage with W

edits.before: Bait your W cooldown, then Q-dash in and R-knockup for the all-in
edits.after: Bait your W, then dash in on 2-stack Mortal Steel and Fate Sealed you

edits.before: Reach crit/on-hit items where his E-rewind undo-button negates your burst
edits.after: Reach crit/on-hit items where Soul Unbound's rewind negates your burst

edits.before: Yone is even-ish at level 1 but you are not — your point-and-click W stun plus a tapped Q thrust is one of the hardest level-1/2 trades in the game, and his W spirit-cleave does almost nothing until it is leveled and stacked. Open trades: W onto him, Q-tap, walk out before his second Q-dash empowers. Hold your E to eat his Q-dash damage if he commits, and never throw a long-range held Q while standing in melee where he can dash onto you.
edits.after: Yone is even-ish at level 1 but you are not — Shield Vault (W) is a point-and-click stun and a tapped Comet Spear (Q) behind it is one of the hardest level-1/2 trades in the game, while Spirit Cleave (W) shields almost nothing unleveled. Open trades: W onto him, Q-tap, walk out before two Mortal Steel hits arm his dash-knockup. Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front, so hold that facing if he commits, and never wind up a long-range Q in melee range.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep control with empowered-Q poke and E-blocking his cleave swings, and at 6 your real lead is Grand Starfall (R) — he can not stop a cross-map leap, so press your tempo into a sidelane or onto his recall rather than chasing a clean 1v1. When you do all-in, bait his E-rewind first: he will spirit-rewind out of your W, so force him to waste it on a feint, then re-W and burst him on the second go.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you keep control with empowered-Q poke and Aegis Assault facing his cleave swings, and at 6 your real lead is Grand Starfall (R) — he cannot stop a cross-map leap, so press tempo into a sidelane or onto his recall rather than chasing a clean 1v1. When you all-in, force Spirit Cleave's shield out first and bait Soul Unbound: rank 1 it is 22 seconds down, and that is your kill window.

edits.before: This is where it flips. By two items Yone is a slippery on-hit/crit carry — his Q-dash gap-closes through you, his R knocks you up, and his E-rewind undoes your entire W-into-empowered-Q burst, while your low base stats plateau hard. You can not out-DPS a fed Yone, so your only late plan is the lead you already built: split, use R to influence other lanes, and end the game before his second and third items come online.
edits.after: This is where it flips. By two items Yone is a slippery on-hit/crit carry — two Mortal Steel hits dash-knockup through you, Fate Sealed drags you back, and Soul Unbound repeats his damage and rewinds him out of your W-into-empowered-Q burst, while your base stats plateau. You cannot out-DPS a fed Yone, so your only late plan is the lead you built: split, use R to influence other lanes, and end before his second and third items land.

edits.before: Your level-1 W is point-and-click stun damage; his W spirit-cleave is near-worthless unstacked, so you win the first trade outright.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-and-click stun damage; his Spirit Cleave shield is near-worthless unstacked, so you win the first trade outright.

edits.before: By two items his crit, on-hit cleave, R-knockup and E-rewind out-scale and out-slip you — concede the duel and close the game on your earlier lead.
edits.after: By two items his crit, Way of the Hunter magic hits, Fate Sealed and Soul Unbound's rewind out-scale you — concede the duel and close on your earlier lead.

edits.before: Burst him — E-block his E burst, dodge his Q3. Pantheon wins by trading around Yone's Soul Unbound and cashing the pattern: burst him early and E-block his E.
edits.after: Burst him before Spirit Cleave's shield is up and keep Aegis Assault facing him. Pantheon wins by committing while Soul Unbound (22s at rank 1) is down.

edits.before: Burst him early and E-block his E. Track Soul Unbound before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Burst early, keep Aegis Assault facing him, track Soul Unbound before each commit, and hold the wave your side.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Yone wins by scaling to crit, eating your burst on Spirit Cleave, then rewinding on Soul Unbound.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Burst him there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22/19/16/13/10s, and he repeats his damage on the rewind. Burst him after it ends. - Spirit Cleave: 14s shield — bait it out first. - Your Grand Starfall: 180s at rank 1, kill windows only.
